compliance.status: settled-with-FSHC; Consent Order with FSHC for 98 Elm Street special needs unit

notes: DCA assigned Present Need of 159; Borough conducted Structural Conditions Survey and determined actual present need is 10 units; mediation set Round 4 Prospective Need at 200 (down from DCA's 260). VLA approved; RDP=4 (one restaurant site at 168 West Crescent Ave, B1005/L19, 1.76 ac, 20 units @ 12 du/ac). Unmet need of 196 addressed through continuation of three overlay zones from Round 3 (Ramsey Golf Course overlay, Allendale Corporate Center overlay expanded to include Block 702 Lot 15, and Franklin Turnpike/Church of Guardian Angel overlay), plus mandatory set-aside ordinance. Fourth Round RDP of 4 addressed by: (1) converting 98 Elm St (Block 1809, Lot 8) to 2-bedroom special needs unit generating 2 units + 1 bonus, and (2) extension of controls on 2 units at Allendale Brook Estates (Block 2101, Lot 9). Candidate snapshot noted prospective_need=200 (correct), rdp=4 (correct), but listed wrong sites (no block/lot for Franklin Turnpike or West Crescent) — corrected from primary doc.

sites.site_name: 98 Elm Street — Special Needs Unit Conversion
sites.adoption_status: Consent Order with FSHC; rehabilitation underway
sites.quote: 98 Elm Street- Unit conversion to 2-bedroom special needs unit and extension of controls (Block 1809, Lot 8) – Existing to be redeveloped, converted with extension of controls.
sites.notes: Generates 2 credits + 1 bonus credit (capped at 25% of RDP=1). Addresses 3 of the 4-unit RDP. This is the former Saddle Dale Builders site from prior rounds, now a foreclosed deed-restricted unit being purchased and rehabilitated by Borough/Allendale Housing Inc. Borough committed $90,000.

sites.adoption_status: in-progress; Borough to exercise purchase rights under expiring deed restrictions
sites.quote: Extension of Controls- Extension of controls at Allendale Brook Estates. [2 credits] ... Block 2101, Lot 9, C0003 / C0007 / C0011 / C0086
sites.notes: Specific condos listed: 3 Trotters Lane (C0003, 3BR, exp 5/15/2032), 7 Trotters Lane (C0007, 1BR, exp 11/4/2032), 11 Trotters Lane (C0011, 2BR, exp 10/15/2032), 86 Carriage Court (C0086, 1BR, exp 12/15/2031).
